lines.trans: What is wrong? Is Director Chun not here?
That matter of Xin Huimei making a fuss belongs to a series of actions, there is collusion with an entertainment reporter.
The situation is urgent now, we have already drafted a crisis public relations plan.
It is like this, Director Chun, he does not want to handle this matter too aggressively.
His meaning is, our plan is too aggressive?
Then was Xin Huimei too aggressive or not!
Chun Yuqiao, he does not want to handle this matter too aggressively, then he should not have caused such an overly aggressive mess himself!
Stella!
No matter what, this is the chief editor office, you are doing public relations, you pay attention to your words for me.
Fine, please pass a message to Chun Yuqiao, whether his own reputation is cleared or not, I cannot control.
